hero.name: Luca
info: Web development, APIs, and software solutions

description: I am a student of the University Degree in Programming at UTN FRVT in Venado Tuerto, Argentina.

I have acquired a solid foundation in software development through my university education, including object-oriented programming, databases, development best practices, and clean code, complementing it with self-taught learning and the development of personal projects.
My main focus is software development with Python and web development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Angular.
Additionally, I have experience working with MySQL, Git, and REST API integration, applying this knowledge in projects that allowed me to develop functional and scalable solutions.
